title: New AJAX export handler without capability or nonce checks
description: A plugin adds an AJAX endpoint that exports subscriber e-mail addresses. The SQL is prepared, but the handler performs no capability check and no nonce check.
context: add_action('wp_ajax_...') registers the handler for any logged-in user, including subscribers. There is no shared permission wrapper in this plugin; each handler performs its own checks.

expected_findings.description: The new wp_ajax_wfb_export_subscribers handler exports subscriber e-mail addresses without current_user_can() or nonce verification, so any logged-in user can call it.

notes: The query itself is correctly prepared; the defect is authorisation only. Reporting SQL injection here is a false positive.
